title: Penny stocks and microcaps: risks and red flags
summary: What penny stocks and microcaps are, why thin trading makes them costly and hard to exit, how dilution, reverse splits and promotions work, and how to recognise pump-and-dump schemes and decide when to stay out.
practicalResult: Work through all three fictional cases in the Penny Stock Red Flag Detector, then write your personal list of conditions under which you will stay out of a small share.
